blocks.text: The label count is the amount you receive.
You are paying Copper Kettle at www.copperkettle.example.
The form wants the digits on the plastic, the month and year, and the short code on the back.
It does not ask for the sign-in secret of your bank site.
The host in the header is the shop you opened. The tag on Brass curtain ring, set of 8 matches the amount due.
No sleeve is ticked. No repeat parcel is marked.
